recent_posts: The Egyptian pound stands at 50.3 to the dollar, after a slight decline of 0.5% over the past week. Despite this, it remains up 1.2% over the past month, while recording a 4.5% decline since the start of the year. #Egypt $EGP
The peso is at 61.4 per dollar, weaker by 4.2% since the start of the year and 7.0% from a year ago. Even so, it typically only moves 0.25% in a day. #Philippines $PHP

The Djiboutian franc trades at 177.7 per dollar, virtually unchanged over the week. It has moved within a tight 1.0% band over the past year, and has not seen a move of 0.25% in five days. #Djibouti $DJF

The Pakistani rupee stands stable at 277.6 to the dollar, with no significant change over the past week. It has not moved by more than 0.25% in eleven days, and it is 2.3% better than its weakest point of the year. #Pakistan $PKR
